resources.title: Northfield Architecture & Naming Reference
resources.description: Lesson 2's complete architecture diagram and resource-naming table — every bucket, Glue object, Redshift workgroup, and Step Functions resource name used throughout the capstone, in one place. Reuse the naming pattern (a consistent project prefix on every resource) for your own project, whether or not you keep the name "northfield".

resources.title: Interview Story Arc Template
resources.description: Lesson 14's five-beat presentation structure (problem, architecture, build, production practices, results) as a fill-in template, plus the "what would you do at scale" answer pattern from the same lesson — reusable for presenting this capstone or any future project.

resources.title: Job Bookmark Troubleshooting Checklist
resources.description: The real, specific ways a Glue job bookmark silently stops working — a renamed transformation_ctx, a changed job name, an accidental --job-bookmark-option override — and how to confirm bookmark state directly instead of guessing, before a "why did this reprocess everything" incident becomes a cost surprise.

resources.title: Data Project Review Rubric
resources.description: A five-dimension rubric (correctness, testing, documentation, performance awareness, maintainability) for reviewing the finished Northfield platform — or any AWS data project — against a real professional standard. Shared across this catalog's data engineering paths.
